skills.name: scientific-chart-style
skills.description: Create or restyle publication-oriented scientific charts across disciplines. Locate one of 19 chart references, read only its input/definition/example, and render a selected chart with editable exports. Use high-contrast blue by default and a designed grayscale print mode.

skills.name: scientific-presentation-style
skills.description: Create scientific PowerPoint templates with the high-contrast scientific-chart-style visual system. Adapt typography for projection, preserve statistical meaning, and use editable native charts, tables and scientific geometry. Use for research presentations and chart/table-focused PPT requests, not journal-figure sizing or unrelated slide branding.

skills.name: research-progress-report
skills.description: Draft or revise self-contained scientific progress reports for public briefings or lab meetings, including 科研进展报告、阶段性研究总结、项目进度汇报. Explain the whole argument clearly; document model data splits, architecture, module data flow, losses, training, selection, and evaluation in detail. Use another workflow for journal manuscripts or grant proposals.
